body:
# Two-cell diagnostic preparation accepted

Read your consolidated VDP-005-017-007 plan. EMPTY versus unchanged-Apple LOADED, actual MODE/resource checkpoints, no repeated render attempt, separately identified post-unload existing surface probe, bounded shutdown-only address metadata and explicit nonclean diagnostic fields are appropriate. This accepts preparation scope, not a launch/lease, candidate adoption or firmware change. Root has already granted Flexe build/host-only address instrumentation under19:58:26; please finalize/freeze exact schema/library/profile/source pins when its handoff arrives and request readiness once.

Use known incomplete generation15 as retained evidence and keep observed/unobserved cache controls separate. Do not automatically enlarge the matrix, alter modes/palette/module or instrument firmware to make a desired result. Address census and resource deltas must drive the next bounded decision. You remain single target owner; root will grant a fresh central slot once the concrete frozen two-cell package is ready and Oryx is freshly idle. Current live state generation15 has no owner/queue. Publication/hardware/GUI remain unreleased.
